description: A Minecraft Mod Which Adds a fully customizable damage tint effect to player armor, enhancing visual feedback when the player takes damage. The feature can be enabled or disabled at any time, and the tint color is fully configurable through an in-game configuration menu—no restart required.

mods.name: Armor Damage Tint
mods.description: Adds customizable damage tint to player armor. Toggle on/off and change the tint color from in-game config.
